headword: {石橋|いしばし}を{叩|たた}いて{渡|わた}る
reading: いしばしをたたいてわたる
gloss: to be extremely cautious; to look before you leap

definitions.gloss: to be extremely cautious; to look before you leap
definitions.explanation: Literally 'to tap a stone bridge before crossing it': to take great care even with something that is already safe. Usually approving, though it can suggest too much caution.

examples.english: He's the type who never takes chances.

examples.english: We moved the plan forward with the utmost caution.
